nodes.label: React design-system components on Radix + Tailwind + Motion in Quiet Paper style
Menu row of DropdownMenu / ContextMenu (MenuRow): icon, label with truncation, trailing slot checked / trailing / shortcut — never wraps
nodes.rationale: One row layout for every menu so a check or shortcut never drops to a second line on narrow widths.
